name: Hrvatski sabor
notes: 151 seats, 11th Sabor (from 16 May 2024). Who sits (mandate status 'Aktivan', a substitute counting for a member on leave) and their party are from the Sabor's own list of representatives (sabor.hr); the list gives no start date. A seat the list does not account for shows as Vacant. Unlit seats mean nothing found, never opposition.
